wariowareinc-v1.1.0.description:
Wario just released a shiny new update for you to play! Wahahahaha!
# Info
* [Info](https://thelx5.github.io/wario_ware_inc/index.html)
* [Setup](https://thelx5.github.io/wario_ware_inc/setup.html)
# Changes
* Microgames now tell you which items they contain in their description
* Added an option that allows players to start with a certain number of microgames unlocked
* Players will **always** start with a minimum of 4 microgames unlocked
* Added an option that allows players to exclude microgames from ever appearing
* Added an option to select which stage will be unlocked at the start
* Players are now able to disable the Introduction Stage
* Allow players to disable stages completely from being added to the pool
* Cutscenes are instantly skipped, this also includes ending cutscenes
* Added several new location groups

# Notes
* The game UI doesn't update until you enter a stage or microgame.
* There's _may_ be a crash (couldn't reproduce) when navigating the microgame menu. Resetting the save will fix any anomalies.
wariowareinc-v1.1.0.title: WarioWare, Inc. - Mega Microgame$! v1.1.0
